assertions.subject: appendicitis
assertions.quote: Approximately 9.4% of patients who undergo appendectomy for complicated appendicitis will develop a postoperative pelvic abscess

assertions.subject: stump appendicitis
assertions.quote: Stump appendicitis, a form of recurrent appendicitis, may occur when an inadequate amount of appendiceal tissue is resected

assertions.subject: post-appendectomy stump appendicitis
assertions.quote: Post-appendectomy stump appendicitis most commonly occurs in cases of perforated appendicitis

assertions.subject: appendectomy
assertions.quote: The mortality associated with appendectomy is low; it is considered a relatively safe procedure

assertions.subject: appendiceal perforation
assertions.quote: Morbidity and mortality after appendiceal perforation are 5.1 per 1000
